a.content: Tender documentation must be retained for 4 years from the conclusion of the procurement procedure.
a.source: PLACEHOLDER: a retention clause of the kind a procurement notice carries. Not drawn from a corpus document; see notes.md.

b.content: Manufacturers shall keep the technical documentation available for the competent authorities for a period of at least 10 years after the last device was placed on the market.
b.source: available for the competent authorities for a period of at least 10 years after the last device covered by the EU declaration of conformity has been placed on the market.
